Many founders, especially those in the VC sphere, tend to view outside investment as a path to an "exit" payday, allowing them to cash out and ride off into a tropical sunset. Tiny has, to be sure, facilitated numerous embarkations of this type. But in my case, the short-term financial aspects of the sale were, for both sides, actually something of an afterthought. Far from exiting anything, I continue to serve as CEO of Norbauer & Co., and, as majority voting shareholder, I retain absolute control—creative and otherwise—over the business.
